review.algorithm_assessment: Each odd-index chain is a finite coin-turning game; a coin at i has Grundy floor(log2(n/i)), and moving onto an occupied box removes both by XOR cancellation. XORing all initial coins telescopes to a bit checksum: bit d of n contributes d xor(d-1), with bit0 contributing0. Count zero-checksum binary numbers using digit DP, then unrank the kth positive one, explicitly skipping n=0.

while ways[-1][0]<=k:

 new=[0]*size
 for value,number in enumerate(old):new[value]+=number;new[value^w]+=number

answer=checksum=0
for pos in range(L-1,-1,-1):
 zero=ways[pos][checksum] if checksum<len(ways[pos]) else 0
 if k>=zero:k-=zero;answer|=1<<pos;checksum^=weights[pos]
print(answer)
"}}
